Name: Quarry Spawn Control
Author: po0pfart
Description:
This mod overhaul quarry's daily spawn with fully configurable spawns chance of gems, ore and coal nodes, dig spot and trees. Also adds geodes, resource clumps, grass and litter category.

Spawn attempt is also configurable, allowing from slow natural like feel to dense and highly rewarding without breaking balance.

Some spawns have its configurable sub category as the following:
[list]
[*]Gem stone consists of diamond, ruby, topaz, emerald, aquamarine, jade and amethyst node
[*]Breakable consists of geode, frozen geode, magma geode and omni geode
[*]Ore nodes consists of copper, iron, gold, iridium and radioactive nodes
[*]Dig spot consists of artifact spot and seed spot
[*]Tree consists of oak, maple, pine, mahogany, palm, mushroom, mystic and green rain tree
[*]Trees spawn at mature stage, ready to be chop for wood instead of just sapling
[*]Grass consists of green grass and blue grass, allowing constant stock of hay
[*]Resource clump consists of boulder, log, stump and meteorite for resource stock
[*]Litter consists of stones, twig, weeds, clay and fossil stone for resource stock
[/list]Checkout my other QoL mods on
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/po0pfart/mods]po0pfart's Mods[/url]
